title: Bounded prewarm keeps a suspended cloud workspace warm on demand
acceptance: ticks.log advances on every tick; a stale tick is a doctor failure; the scheduled task refuses a source checkout; the activity window is at least the tick cadence (refused otherwise) and self-sizes to the interval since that workspace was last decided on, capped
notes: Built 2026-11-26: ps/bin/prewarm-cloud.ps1 + ps/tests/test-prewarm-cloud.ps1 + ps/tests/test-agentq-prewarm-verb.ps1; registered in gateSuites.agentq (source 29 == installed 29). Commits 270fb69, 698330e, 47e88f7 — installed and guarded, the guard proved on the installed copy (7 assertions). agentq doctor gains a prewarm check (a tick older than AGENTQ_PREWARM_MAX_AGE_MIN=30 is a FAIL) and codai-workspace-prewarm joins the scheduled-tasks list. 2026-11-27, measured on real data: with -ActivityMin 10 against a PT20M cadence, 84 of 413 (workspace, tick) pairs whose activity fell inside a 25 min window were INVISIBLE to the 10 min one - 20 % of the ticks that had something to warm ran blind. The trigger also misses: 10 of 105 observed tick intervals ran past the cadence and 3 past 25 min (worst 99.8 min), each while the machine was heavily loaded, and none of them was a sleep (no Kernel-Power 42/107), so no fixed window can be enough. Fixed in four parts: (a) -ActivityMin default 10 -> 25 and the live task's action widened (read back, wrapper intact); (b) the window now sizes itself from prewarm/last-tick-<ws>, written when a round starts, capped by -MaxWindowMin 45 (past that the warm is pointless: the work is already 45 min stale); (c) -VerifyTask reads the trigger and refuses a window below cadence + 5 min, proved RED on the live task at 10 and GREEN at 25; (d) 8 new assertions in ps/tests/test-prewarm-cloud.ps1 (5 for the guard, 3 for the self-sizing window and its cap), suite 45 passed / 0 failed. Landed 4ca9032 (ps/bin/prewarm-cloud.ps1, ps/tests/test-prewarm-cloud.ps1, docs/TRACKER.csv; pushed to origin/main; the sibling WIP in ps/bin/* untouched). Post-change live proof on DRAGOS: the scheduled task ran itself at 03:23:01Z with LastTaskResult 0, the tick log grew to 2037 lines carrying the new floor text, and per-workspace stamps exist for all 6 ticked workspaces aged 0.7-3.0 min. Committed copy == working tree == installed copy, sha256 7BAD47040BEECC4B, 36289 B. Open: the 7-day tick-continuity count.

acceptance: Every verb of the read-only and coordination surface has a recorded spawn count on the shim fixture with the A/B on the SAME slot; a fix must lower the count and change no output; the suite input map has an entry for every name in gateSuites.agentq so an unrelated suite can be skipped
notes: 2026-11-28 (round 4): harness is a git.cmd shim first on PATH that appends %* to a log and calls the real git; one arm at a time on one fixture; wall-clock rejected as a signal (a 169 s gate pool measured 792 s while the machine was loaded). Table: lease 5 (fresh) / 2 (reuse via -Slot), status 1, status -Json 1, log 1, note 1, lessons 1, doctor -Quiet 1, since 3 (4 before), who 0, metrics 0, scale 0, probe 0, slo 0, lease-check 0, renew 0, a refused verb 1 each. Fix: since asked git twice for the same answer - rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{u} existed only to choose the next argument, so the branch path and the no-upstream fallback now share ONE log call; 4 -> 3, output byte-identical with and without an upstream. Input map: 8 of 44 names in gateSuites.agentq had no entry, and an unknown suite always RUNS (fail-open), so those 8 could never be skipped; +9 entries (the ninth is land stale base), now 44/44 with 0 missing and 0 extra, proved by Select-AqSuites reporting run=2 skip=42 and by suite gate input selection 30/30. The LEDGER now names the verb (2026-11-28, target 3): hook-pre.ps1 writes it for the tools that carry a command, sat-report.ps1 sums the day per verb in the same single pass (verb, calls, served, spawned, avg ms, VERB COVERAGE rows/with-verb), with one regex and NO spawn and no ConvertFrom-Json (this round IS the spawn count); the field is always present, empty when no agentq verb runs or a flag precedes it, bounded to [A-Za-z0-9-]{1,24}. agentq-slo.mjs and agentq-prune.ps1 needed no change (JSON.parse by name; file-NAME match). Guards: sat-report 16/16 with the three status fixture rows in three cost classes, hook-pre +11 (six recognised shapes, four that must stay empty). Read-only surface now measured in FULL (status, log, since, lessons, metrics, doctor, help, timings): the last two, help and timings, cost 0 spawns each, so git is spawned only by the verbs that read the repository; recover (dry run) 2, and plain doctor 159 against 1 for doctor -Quiet, which is the difference between the cheapest and the most expensive read-only verb. The suite that guards the classifier was found to be a dead suite: test-sat-report.ps1 was in NEITHER the run-all.ps1 suite map nor the install.ps1 map, so the VERB COVERAGE assertions could never fail. Registering it in run-all.ps1 alone turned install wiring red on all three of its checks (1 missing: test-sat-report.ps1; every suite -File must be a map key; gateSuites.agentq must be a fully installed list), which is the guard working; mapping bin\sat-report.ps1 and its test together turned it green at pass=19 fail=0. PROVEN through the sanctioned runner: run-all.ps1 -Only hook pre,sat report,install wiring = 60/60 + 16/16 + 19/19, RUNALL_EXIT=0, against failed=1 for the same command before the map fix."
